boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Vincent College
boards.description: Current, under-21-safe food options in Latrobe with directly verified evening hours. Confirm availability before leaving, especially for drive-thru and weekend service.

cards.title: McDonald's at Mount Laurel Plaza
cards.subtitle: 110 Mount Laurel Plaza, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when an evening meal is needed; the official location page lists daily drive-thru service until 11 PM.
cards.short_summary: A daily 11 PM drive-thru option in Mount Laurel Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists drive-thru hours of 5 AM–11 PM every day at 110 Mount Laurel Plaza in Latrobe.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed daily until 11 PM; lobby hours are listed until 10 PM.

cards.title: Eat'n Park Latrobe
cards.subtitle: 1026 Mountain Laurel Plaza, Latrobe
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, pickup-window, or delivery service for a full-menu stop; check the location page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant option listed open until 11 PM every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Eat'n Park lists its Latrobe restaurant at 1026 Mountain Laurel Plaza as open 7 AM–11 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily hours of 7 AM–11 PM and pickup-window service.

cards.title: Taco Bell at Mountain Laurel Plaza
cards.subtitle: 1022 Mountain Laurel Plaza, Latrobe
cards.notes: Plan on drive-thru service for the latest window; the official listing separates drive-thru hours from earlier dine-in hours.
cards.short_summary: Drive-thru service runs as late as 3 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3 AM Friday–Saturday at 1022 Mountain Laurel Plaza.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1022 Mountain Laurel Plaza, Latrobe
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 2 AM most nights and 3 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Wendy's at Latrobe Thirty Plaza
cards.subtitle: 10 Latrobe Thirty Plaza, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use restaurant or drive-thru service for a late meal; both sets of official hours run to midnight every day.
cards.short_summary: A midnight option with restaurant and drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 AM–12 AM daily at 10 Latrobe Thirty Plaza.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists both restaurant and drive-thru open until 12 AM daily.

cards.title: Papa Johns Pizza on Colony Lane
cards.subtitle: 205 Colony Lane, Latrobe
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order through the store page and allow extra time near the listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: Carryout and delivery are listed until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists carryout and delivery until 11 PM Sunday–Thursday and 12 AM Friday–Saturday at 205 Colony Lane.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza — 205 Colony Lane, Latrobe
cards.access_notes: Carryout and delivery are listed until 11 PM most nights and midnight Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Domino's on Route 30
cards.subtitle: 3960 Route 30, Suite 102, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use the official store page to order delivery or carryout; it identifies this Route 30 location as open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Route 30 pizza stop listed open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Latrobe store page lists 3960 Route 30, Suite 102 and states it is open until 12 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official store page lists the location as open until 12 AM; use its order flow for current service availability.

cards.title: KFC at Latrobe Thirty Plaza
cards.subtitle: 1004 Latrobe Thirty Plaza, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use carryout, delivery, or drive-thru for an evening order; the official location listing posts a 10:30 PM close every day.
cards.short_summary: A daily 10:30 PM quick-service option.
cards.evidence_claim: KFC lists its 1004 Latrobe Thirty Plaza location as open 10:30 AM–10:30 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official listing gives daily hours of 10:30 AM–10:30 PM and names carryout, delivery, and drive-thru.

cards.title: Pitstop Pizza & Subs
cards.subtitle: 1703 Ligonier Street, Latrobe
cards.notes: Call ahead or use online ordering for slices, pizza, and subs; Friday and Saturday hours extend through 10 PM.
cards.short_summary: A downtown-adjacent pizza counter with 10 PM weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitstop Pizza & Subs lists Friday–Saturday hours of 11 AM–10 PM at 1703 Ligonier Street.
cards.source_title: Pitstop Pizza & Subs — Menu and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday service until 10 PM; Monday–Thursday closes at 9 PM and Sunday at 8 PM.

cards.title: Denny's on Route 30 West
cards.subtitle: 3870 US State Route 30 West, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use the official restaurant page for dine-in, pickup, or delivery and check its live ordering status before traveling.
cards.short_summary: An all-day-breakfast location whose official page says it serves food 24/7.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official page for 3870 US State Route 30 West says the Latrobe restaurant serves all-day breakfast and food 24/7.
cards.source_title: Denny's — 3870 US State Route 30 West, Latrobe
cards.access_notes: The official page states it serves food 24/7, while its ordering-status display can vary; confirm current service before leaving.

cards.title: Jioio's Family Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 6067 Route 981, Latrobe
cards.notes: Use this Route 981 restaurant for an early-evening pizza or Italian-food order; Friday and Saturday hours are listed until 9 PM.
cards.short_summary: A family restaurant with 9 PM Friday and Saturday closing hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Jioio's lists Friday and Saturday hours of 2 PM–9 PM at its 6067 Route 981 Latrobe restaurant.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday service until 9 PM; Sunday closes at 8 PM and Monday–Thursday at 8 PM.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Saint Vincent spaces for studying, creating, gathering, reflection, and outdoor learning.

cards.title: Dale P. Latimer Library
cards.subtitle: Research, quiet work, and group study
cards.notes: Bring a laptop for Wi-Fi, choose a quiet area or reserve an appropriate group-study room, then use the catalog or ask at circulation for research help.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with places for both focused work and collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent identifies the Latimer Library as a hub for academic work and collaboration, with quiet areas, group study rooms, research resources, and Wi-Fi.
cards.access_notes: Building and service hours vary during the year; check the library schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Robert S. Carey Student Center
cards.subtitle: A multi-use campus gathering point
cards.notes: Use the building as a practical meet-up point before a campus program, then confirm which areas and activities are open that day through Student Life or event listings.
cards.short_summary: The student center combines student services, recreation, arts, and gathering spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The College catalog says the Carey Student Center contains the student union, game room, fitness center, Performing Arts Center, pool, Chapel, bookstore, The Shack, and other campus spaces.
cards.access_notes: Individual facilities and programs may have separate access requirements or schedules.

cards.title: Citrone Family Commuter Center
cards.subtitle: Placid Hall’s dedicated commuter lounge
cards.notes: Commuter students can use downtime between classes at the tables, kitchenette, pool table, TV, and wireless internet; check in with commuter affairs for current access details.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-built lounge for Saint Vincent’s commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent describes the Citrone Family Commuter Center as a first-floor Placid Hall commuter lounge with a kitchenette, study tables, pool table, TV, and wireless internet.
cards.access_notes: This space is designated for commuter students.

cards.title: Saint Benedict Hall Pod Lounges
cards.subtitle: First-year community spaces
cards.notes: First-year residents can use their pod lounge for a game, program, Bible study, or informal time with neighbors while following residence-hall guest and quiet-hour rules.
cards.short_summary: Each first-year pod has a themed lounge designed for shared activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent says Saint Benedict Hall has 21 first-year pods, each with its own themed lounge for bonding and activities; programs, games, and Bible studies occur in pod life.
cards.access_notes: Residential access is for authorized students and subject to housing policies.

cards.entity_name: Mary, Mother of Wisdom Student Chapel
cards.title: Mary, Mother of Wisdom Student Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry worship and reflection
cards.notes: Check Campus Ministry’s current service schedule, then attend a listed Mass, prayer service, or worship program in the College’s student chapel.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student chapel within the Carey Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Ministry states that it holds weekly services in Mary, Mother of Wisdom Student Chapel and invites students to participate as lectors, cantors, ushers, and hospitality ministers.
cards.access_notes: Service times are published by Campus Ministry; participation should follow the current schedule.

cards.title: Saint Vincent Archabbey Basilica
cards.subtitle: Weekly Campus Ministry services
cards.notes: Look up the current Campus Ministry worship schedule and attend a listed service in the Basilica; students interested in ministry roles can contact Campus Ministry.
cards.short_summary: A major campus worship site shared with the student chapel’s weekly schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent Campus Ministry says it has weekly service times in the Archabbey Basilica and the Mary, Mother of Wisdom Student Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Use the current Campus Ministry schedule for service times and visitor guidance.

cards.title: Winnie Palmer Nature Reserve
cards.subtitle: Trails, wetlands, and outdoor learning
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk on the reserve’s trails or join a relevant class or program; stay on marked routes and respect the protected woodlands, wetlands, and meadows.
cards.short_summary: A 50-acre reserve near campus with trails and environmental-learning facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent says the reserve includes more than 50 acres of protected land, two miles of trails, an Environmental Learning Barn, and opportunities for student study, work, and exploration.
cards.access_notes: Use established trails and follow posted reserve guidance; some academic activities are course- or program-based.

cards.entity_name: Angelo Taiani Planetarium and Astronaut Exhibit
cards.title: Angelo Taiani Planetarium and Astronaut Exhibit
cards.subtitle: Dupré Science Pavilion
cards.notes: Watch for a scheduled planetarium program or class event, and pair the visit with a look at the astronaut exhibit in the Science Pavilion.
cards.short_summary: A named astronomy destination inside the Science Pavilion.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boyer School lists the Angelo Taiani Planetarium and Astronaut Exhibit among the facilities inside the Sis and Herman Dupré Science Pavilion.
cards.source_title: Dupré Science Pavilion Facilities | Saint Vincent College
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on academic programming and facility access; confirm before making a special trip.

cards.title: General Computing Lab
cards.subtitle: WG-02, Dupré Science Pavilion
cards.notes: Use an open-work period to complete coursework on a desktop computer or print materials, while yielding priority to scheduled classes and following lab rules.
cards.short_summary: A computer lab that the College explicitly identifies as student study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent says the General Computing Lab in WG-02 has 24 desktop computers and two printers and is open to students for assignments and study space.
cards.source_title: Dupré Science Pavilion Facilities | Saint Vincent College
cards.access_notes: The lab is also used for classes; verify availability before relying on a workstation.

cards.title: Fred M. Rogers Center
cards.subtitle: Archives, gallery, and campus events
cards.notes: Check the Center’s or College’s public schedule for an exhibition, talk, or event, and plan your visit around the specific space or program that is open.
cards.short_summary: A campus center housing Fred Rogers archival material and a coverlet gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saint Vincent College catalog says the Fred M. Rogers Center houses the Fred Rogers Archive and the Foster and Muriel McCarl Coverlet Gallery.
cards.access_notes: Gallery, archive, and event access can vary; consult the current College schedule before visiting.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe outdoor and campus activities with no admission or purchase required.

cards.title: Walk the Lakeside Loop
cards.subtitle: Keystone State Park, near Latrobe
cards.notes: Meet at the trailhead and take the flat, ADA-accessible loop around Keystone Lake; pause together at the causeway or dam viewpoints.
cards.short_summary: A two-mile lakeside loop with accessible terrain and wildlife-viewing opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: Keystone State Park’s Lakeside Loop is a 2.0-mile easiest-rated loop open for hiking and biking, with restrooms, water, and picnic tables at the trailhead.
cards.access_notes: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; follow posted park rules and trail conditions.

cards.title: Loop Davis Run Trail
cards.subtitle: Keystone State Park, near Latrobe
cards.notes: Choose the 1.25-mile Davis Run loop for a walking conversation through wetlands and upland forest; bring water and stay on marked paths.
cards.short_summary: A more-difficult loop that moves from wetlands into mixed forest.
cards.evidence_claim: Davis Run Trail is a 1.25-mile, more-difficult hiking loop at Keystone State Park and passes wetlands and upland forest.
cards.access_notes: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; use the marked hiking route.

cards.title: Hike McCune Run Trail
cards.subtitle: Keystone State Park, near Latrobe
cards.notes: Make a small-group plan for the 1.8-mile McCune Run loop, then connect only where trail signs and your route plan allow.
cards.short_summary: A 1.8-mile wooded loop that links with other Keystone trails.
cards.evidence_claim: McCune Run Trail is a 1.8-mile, more-difficult hiking loop at Keystone State Park that connects with Strawcutter and Davis Run trails.
cards.access_notes: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; stay on marked trails and use daylight hours.

cards.title: Take the Pine Trail
cards.subtitle: Keystone State Park, near Latrobe
cards.notes: Use this short connector for a low-commitment outdoor reset, stopping to look for birds and butterflies without leaving the trail corridor.
cards.short_summary: A brief pine-plantation connector suited to an easy outdoor break.
cards.evidence_claim: Pine Trail is a 0.3-mile easiest-rated connector trail at Keystone State Park; the page notes views of farm fields and large chestnut oaks.
cards.access_notes: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; wear appropriate shoes for natural-surface trails.

cards.title: Climb Stone Lodge Trail
cards.subtitle: Keystone State Park, near Latrobe
cards.notes: Gather a prepared group for this steeper loop from the visitor-center parking area; allow time to return well before dark.
cards.short_summary: A challenging forest loop with remnants of a springhouse and homestead.
cards.evidence_claim: Stone Lodge Trail is a 1.8-mile most-difficult loop beginning at the James A. Kell Visitor Center parking lot.
cards.access_notes: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; this route is rated most difficult, so choose it only if the group is prepared.

cards.title: Stroll Strawcutter Trail
cards.subtitle: Keystone State Park, near Latrobe
cards.notes: Walk the easier two-mile Strawcutter loop and use the wetland, meadow, and pine sections as natural conversation stops.
cards.short_summary: An easy loop crossing meadow, wetland, and pine-forest settings.
cards.evidence_claim: Strawcutter Trail is a 2.0-mile easiest-rated loop at Keystone State Park that passes a wetland, meadow, and pine forest.
cards.access_notes: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; remain on the designated trail.

cards.title: Watch for Migrating Birds
cards.subtitle: Keystone State Park, near Latrobe
cards.notes: Bring binoculars if you have them, scan quietly from established areas, and observe wildlife without approaching or handling any animals.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal bird-and-wildlife observation outing around Keystone’s lake and habitats.
cards.evidence_claim: Keystone State Park reports that warblers, kinglets, buffleheads, mergansers, herons, osprey, and other birds migrate through the park.
cards.source_title: Wildlife Watching at Keystone State Park
cards.access_notes: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; observe animals from a distance and do not handle them.

cards.title: Day Hike the Laurel Highlands Trail
cards.subtitle: Laurel Ridge State Park
cards.notes: Pick a daylight section from a designated trailhead, share the route with the group, and use the voluntary day-use registration mailbox.
cards.short_summary: A choose-your-distance day hike on Laurel Ridge’s long-distance trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Laurel Ridge State Park’s main feature is the 70-mile Laurel Highlands Hiking Trail; day hikers are asked to use voluntary registration mailboxes at trailheads.
cards.source_title: Stay the Night at Laurel Ridge State Park
cards.access_notes: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee. This card is for day hiking only; overnight use requires a reservation and fee.

cards.title: See Adams Falls
cards.subtitle: Linn Run State Park
cards.notes: Walk the one-mile loop with friends, stay on the designated route near the waterfall, and leave time to return before dusk.
cards.short_summary: A short state-park waterfall walk through rhododendron and hemlock.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR describes Adams Falls Trail at Linn Run State Park as a one-mile loop leading to a mountain waterfall among rhododendron and hemlock.
cards.access_notes: Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee; use care around water and remain on the marked trail.

cards.title: Visit the Wetland Boardwalk
cards.subtitle: Winnie Palmer Nature Reserve, Saint Vincent College
cards.notes: Meet at the reserve and take a slow boardwalk lap to look for marsh birds and native plants; respect the habitat and posted rules.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent marsh boardwalk for a low-key nature walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Winnie Palmer Nature Reserve identifies its Wetland Boardwalk as a place to see native marshes, red-winged blackbirds, cattails, and jewelweed.
cards.access_notes: The reserve lists trail hours as daily dawn to dusk and does not list an admission charge for visiting its trails.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Saint Vincent observances and recurring campus rituals, from Founders’ Day to graduation’s Ave Maria Bell.

cards.title: Founders’ Day
cards.subtitle: Annual November 20 observance
cards.notes: Plan around November 20 to see Saint Vincent mark its 1846 founding with a convocation, dinner, campus activities and fireworks.
cards.short_summary: The campus birthday observance for Saint Vincent’s 1846 founding.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent says students, alumni and faculty celebrate Founders’ Day on November 20 with a special convocation, turkey dinner, campus activities and fireworks.
cards.access_notes: A scheduled annual observance; consult the College calendar for current details.

cards.title: Founders’ Day Vespers
cards.subtitle: Archabbey Basilica opening observance
cards.notes: Attend the Vespers and Honors Convocation portion to see the annual remembrance begin in the Saint Vincent Archabbey Basilica.
cards.short_summary: Prayer opens the College’s annual Founders’ Day observance.
cards.evidence_claim: The College reported that its 2025 annual Founders’ Day began with Vespers and Honors Convocation in Saint Vincent Archabbey Basilica.
cards.source_title: SVC celebrates Honors Convocation, Founders’ Day
cards.access_notes: Part of the annual Founders’ Day program; confirm attendance arrangements with the College.

cards.title: Wimmerfest Community Dinner
cards.subtitle: Founders’ Day community meal
cards.notes: If the current program includes it, reserve early for this named Founders’ Day dinner honoring Boniface Wimmer and the Benedictine founders.
cards.short_summary: A named community dinner within the Founders’ Day celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent’s 2022 Founders’ Day program continued with the Wimmerfest Community Dinner after Vespers and Honors Convocation.
cards.source_title: Saint Vincent College will celebrate Founders’ Day
cards.access_notes: The 2022 program required dinner reservations; availability and format can change.

cards.title: Founders’ Day Campus Light-Up
cards.subtitle: Christmas-season light-up and fireworks
cards.notes: Stay through the evening program when offered: Founders’ Day has paired its campus Christmas light-up with a fireworks show.
cards.short_summary: Founders’ Day rolls into the Christmas season with lights and fireworks.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent reported that the 2025 Founders’ Day observance was followed by a campus light-up for the Christmas season and fireworks.
cards.source_title: SVC celebrates Honors Convocation, Founders’ Day
cards.access_notes: Part of the annual Founders’ Day program; verify current schedule and viewing guidance.

cards.title: Sports Friendship Day
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry’s annual inclusion event
cards.notes: Volunteer as a student buddy when registration opens, or support the day’s light sports, crafts, karaoke and face-painting activities.
cards.short_summary: Students partner with participants for a long-running day of activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent described its 39th annual Sports Friendship Day as a beloved College tradition, pairing participants with student buddies.
cards.source_title: Saint Vincent College hosts 39th annual Sports Friendship Day
cards.access_notes: Participation is organized through Campus Ministry; follow current event registration guidance.

cards.title: Homecoming Court at Halftime
cards.subtitle: Chuck Noll Field homecoming ritual
cards.notes: Catch the designated homecoming football halftime to see the senior court recognized before the elected queen and king are announced.
cards.short_summary: Homecoming court recognition happens on the field at halftime.
cards.evidence_claim: At the 2025 annual Homecoming Weekend, Saint Vincent recognized its senior court at football halftime before announcing the elected queen and king.
cards.source_title: Saint Vincent College crowns Homecoming Queen and King, hosts annual Homecoming Weekend
cards.access_notes: Occurs during annual Homecoming Weekend; game entry requirements may apply.

cards.title: The President’s Award
cards.subtitle: Spring Honors Convocation’s highest student honor
cards.notes: Watch the Spring Honors Convocation to see the College recognize one graduating student for achievement, leadership and community service.
cards.short_summary: A graduating senior receives Saint Vincent’s highest student honor.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent presented its 52nd annual President’s Award at the 2026 Spring Honors Convocation; the College calls it its highest student honor.
cards.source_title: Saint Vincent College students, faculty recognized at 2026 Spring Honors Convocation
cards.access_notes: The award is presented at the Spring Honors Convocation; check the College’s current event listing.

cards.title: Spring Commencement
cards.subtitle: Annual degree-conferral ceremony
cards.notes: Celebrate the graduating class at the spring ceremony, where the College confers degrees and closes with a benediction.
cards.short_summary: Saint Vincent’s principal spring graduation ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent held its 180th Spring Commencement on May 9, 2026, awarding bachelor’s and master’s degrees and certificates.
cards.source_title: Saint Vincent College holds 180th Spring Commencement
cards.access_notes: Held annually; guest access, venue and timing are announced with each commencement.

cards.title: Ring the Ave Maria Bell
cards.subtitle: Post-commencement graduation ritual
cards.notes: After the commencement ceremony, look for the graduates’ Ave Maria Bell ringing—an especially photo-friendly final moment of the day.
cards.short_summary: Graduates mark commencement by ringing the Ave Maria Bell.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent documented graduates ringing the Ave Maria Bell after the 2026 Spring Commencement Ceremony.
cards.source_title: Saint Vincent College holds 180th Spring Commencement
cards.access_notes: A post-ceremony graduation moment; follow event staff directions for viewing and photos.

cards.title: Winter Commencement
cards.subtitle: Annual December graduation ceremony
cards.notes: For December graduates, follow the winter ceremony announcements; the College’s 21st annual event included an invocation, address and benediction.
cards.short_summary: A separate annual commencement for December graduates.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent held its 21st annual Winter Commencement on December 13, 2025, awarding 77 degrees or certificates.
cards.source_title: Saint Vincent College celebrates 21st Winter Commencement
cards.access_notes: Held annually in December; check the current commencement announcement for guest logistics.
